summary.text: Use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service. Ending your policy means losing existing benefits.

details.heading: What you will lose
details.body: You will lose all existing benefits when you terminate your ElderShield policy.

details.heading: If you later join CareShield Life
details.body: You may have to go for a medical assessment if you wish to join CareShield Life.

steps.name: Terminate the policy
steps.text: Use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service to end your ElderShield policy.
